S-F.title: A Day in Paris: Dining, Landmarks, and Reflections
S-F.text:
A Day in Paris: Dining, Landmarks, and Reflections

In a Parisian setting, a person wearing a jacket, hat, and glasses sits at a table. The individual holds a pizza topped with strawberries and blueberries while also touching a smoothie. A second view shows a plate on the table containing a pancake with a visible filling, alongside a fork and knife resting on the surface.

Looking upward from a street level, a French tricolor flag hangs from a pole against a blue sky filled with clouds. Contrails stretch across the sky, connecting cloud formations above the urban environment.

Inside a cathedral, statues stand on pillars and pedestals; one figure wears a robe and looks downward, while another is clad in armor holding a sword and helmet. Large stained glass windows reflect light, displaying colorful patterns and religious scenes within arched frames. Outside, crowds gather on the sidewalk before the large historical building, which features towers, arches, and a rose window. Nearby, a carousel stands in front of the structure.

A person holds up a smartphone displaying an image of a woman walking along a tree-lined path toward a sunset. In another scene, an individual sits on a chair or bench near water where ducks swim and birds fly overhead. A fountain sprays water nearby, with buildings and trees visible in the background under a cloudy sky.

S-C0.title: Traces of a City
S-C0.text:
Traces of a City

A table holds a plate with a broken pancake containing egg and meat filling, alongside an empty glass and cutlery. Nearby, someone sits wearing a jacket and hat, holding a slice of pizza topped with strawberries and blueberries while drinking from a smoothie cup. The person looks toward a window, touching the drink.

Above a street, a tricolor flag hangs from a pole against a blue sky filled with clouds. White trails stretch across the heavens, connecting and fading among the cloud formations.

Inside a cathedral, a statue of a woman in robes stands on a pillar, looking downward. Stained glass windows illuminate the space, reflecting light through colorful patterns and religious scenes framed by Gothic arches. Another statue depicts a figure in armor holding a sword and helmet, posed heroically on a pedestal. Outside, crowds gather before the large historical building, walking along sidewalks and looking up at towers. A carousel stands nearby where people wear coats and hats.

A person holds up a smartphone displaying an image of a woman walking along a tree-lined path extending into the distance under a cloudy sunset sky. Someone sits on a chair wearing a jacket, looking toward water where ducks swim near a fountain. Birds fly overhead while trees grow beside buildings in the background.

As I move from the meal, I see open skies and distant movement above the streets.

From the street view, I turn my attention inward to stone and light within the cathedral.

I carry these images as quiet witnesses to places I have passed through. They hold the rhythm of days spent moving between meals, monuments, and moments of stillness.

These fragments remain as they were captured: food on plates, flags in wind, statues in shadow, and people in motion. I return to them not to claim ownership, but to remember what was there when I looked.

S-C1.title: Paris Through My Lens
S-C1.text:
Paris Through My Lens

A person sits at a table with pizza topped with strawberries and blueberries, holding a slice while looking toward a window. Nearby, another plate holds a broken pancake with egg and meat filling beside a fork and knife. Capturing this scene, I felt neutral at first, then happy as the light softened across the food.

Above a street, a French flag hangs from a pole against a blue sky streaked with clouds and faint trails. The tricolor fabric displays clearly in daylight. While photographing this view, I felt calm watching the stillness of the flag against the moving sky.

Inside a cathedral, a statue of a woman in a robe stands near a pillar with hands visible and face looking downward. Stained glass windows illuminate the space with colorful religious scenes, their arches framing the high ceiling. Another statue depicts a figure in armor holding a sword on a pedestal. Outside, crowds gather before large cathedral towers. A carousel stands in front of a building where people in coats stand nearby. Taking these photos, I felt excited by the architecture, happy observing details, and calm when focusing on the carousel.

A person holds up a smartphone displaying an image of a woman walking along a tree-lined path toward sunset under cloudy skies. In another view, someone sits on a chair wearing a jacket, looking toward water where ducks swim near a fountain. Birds fly overhead while buildings form the background. Photographing these moments, I felt neutral capturing the phone screen, then calm as I framed the seated figure by the water.

The meal gives way to open sky, and I shift my focus from indoor warmth to outdoor stillness.

Leaving the streets, I turn inward to stone and stained glass.

I carry a camera to capture the rhythm of Paris, not as a participant but as an observer. Each frame holds a quiet moment where I felt something specific while pressing the shutter.

These images remain separate yet connected by my presence behind the lens. I return to that same quiet observation, letting each mood settle without explanation.
